coverage_definition: Main successful revised urupocidin A/B routes and SI isolated precursor, syn-diol and configuration-assignment branches. Known alcohol 4 and cited upstream syntheses bound coverage; cascade mechanisms excluded and three unisolated preparative graphs explicitly inferred.

issues.detail: This work synthesizes revised 8R,10S,15S structures 2a/2b. Proposed structures 1a/1b and mechanistic intermediates are not forward-synthesis products in this dataset.
issues.subject: 2a/2b

issues.detail: Canonical SMILES retain dication and two trifluoroacetate counterions drawn in source; HRMS uses neutral-parent [M+H]+, not entire salt mass.
issues.subject: 2a/2b

issues.detail: 97% refers to anti:syn 88:12 combined material before second chromatography. Only anti-9 proceeds to lactonization; no individual yields inferred.
issues.subject: 9/syn-9

issues.detail: Main Scheme 2 claims 98% ee at 17a, while SI HPLC of 6a gives 96% ee. Preserve measured downstream value without assigning pure enantiomer status.
issues.subject: 17a/6a

issues.detail: Main reports 74% over lactonization/protection, but SI isolated yields are 90% and 87%. Store stage yields without forcing agreement.
SI scheme says toluene; SI procedure and main scheme say benzene. Use procedure solvent and preserve discrepancy.
issues.subject: S2

issues.detail: SI gives 56% deprotection and different rotation than main 55%; preserve SI as primary and main as conflicting claim.
issues.subject: 2a

issues.detail: Known hydroxyguanidine alcohol 4 and cited precursor preparations remain upstream boundaries; not commercial-start completeness.
Structures interpret explicitly described unisolated primary alcohol and free amine preparations; no separate isolated yields assigned.
issues.subject: 19-alcohol/22a-amine/22b-amine

issues.detail: THP acetal stereochemistry and hydroxyguanidine protecting-group imino geometry are not assigned by source. Preserve unspecified stereo.
issues.subject: 4/S7/S8

issues.detail: Source reports quantitative S4 although product amount exceeds input in mmol; retain qualitative yield without deriving a numeric value.
issues.subject: S4

issues.detail: Main comparison headings repeat locant 15 where position 10 is intended. Core configuration follows scheme and explicit 8R,10S,15S conclusion.
issues.subject: Tables 1/2
